patthana21.34:1.1: Nahetuṃ naatītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.34:2.1: Nahetuṃ naanāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.34:3.1: Nahetuṃ napaccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
